evals.name: product-pipeline-diagnosis
evals.prompt: Why are we not driving pipeline from our Product channel? What is the problem?
evals.expected_output: A leader-mode diagnostic that pulls live SFDC data on the Product cohort, identifies the specific leaky gate (likely cohort→meeting given the question), matches it to a named failure mode from the diagnostic pattern framework, and recommends a specific action with Who/What/By when filled in.

evals.name: inbound-show-rate-drop
evals.prompt: Our Inbound show rate seems to have dropped lately. Diagnose what's happening and tell me what to do about it.
evals.expected_output: A focused Gate-2 (show rate) diagnosis with period-over-period comparison, identification of one of the three known show-rate failure modes (booking window, confirmation workflow, stakeholder quality), and a specific action.

evals.name: rep-drill-outbound
evals.prompt: Drill into one of our Outbound AEs — pick one with enough cohort data — and show me their strike zone vs. team baseline. What does this rep need to focus on?
evals.expected_output: A rep-mode tactical diagnostic. Picks a real Outbound AE from SFDC, pulls their cohort, compares per-gate conversion to team baseline, identifies their weakest gate, and gives tactical recommendations (specific accounts, messaging changes) — not structural leader-mode changes.
